_comment: LIBRARY TEMPLATE — a Canton Network Token Standard (CIP-0056) transfer,
against ANY registry that implements TransferFactory.
The measured operation is the standard interface choice itself, so this
file does not need to know anything about the implementation behind it.
What differs between registries is only how holdings are created and how
the factory is constructed — supplied as parameters.
→ lists the parameters this template needs
Worked invocations for two different registries are in workloads/README.md.

setup._comment: The registry's factory. Its template and fields are implementation-specific.
The sending wallet's holdings. One per measured transfer, so a transfer normally has its own input to spend.

operations._comment: The standard transfer — identical for every conforming registry.
